item.text: {"verdict":"revise","issues":[{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:32"],"location":"verified_account.transitions; support_handoff.task_message","message":"A hardship mention routes directly to support_handoff when the customer accepts support. That path can skip a date or amount the customer names themselves, even though rule 32 requires recording that promise under the date and amount rules. For example, a customer mentions job loss, says they can pay the floor on a valid date, and accepts support: the workflow transfers without confirming or attempting to record the promise.","fix":"Handle any customer-named date or amount under rules 7 and 8 before completing the hardship disposition. If a promise is recorded and the customer also accepts support, transfer and close as transferred/support, preserving the recorded promise."},{"severity":"warning","source_ids":["brief-a:6","brief-a:46"],"location":"callback.task_message; schedule_callback post_process_code","message":"The source directs the workflow to close as not_reached/callback after scheduling, but does not specify the disposition when a valid callback request fails at the tool. The workflow selects no_callback on failure, which is plausible but not source-grounded.","fix":"Clarify the source policy for callback tool failure, or document the chosen failure disposition as an explicit amendment."},{"severity":"warning","source_ids":["brief-a:16","brief-a:25","brief-a:46"],"location":"verified_account.task_message; account_lookup post_process_code","message":"The workflow assigns service_error when account lookup fails or returns no usable product, but the source does not specify a lookup-failure outcome or how to resolve an account response that does not provide one unambiguous product.","fix":"Add an explicit source policy for lookup errors and ambiguous or empty product results, including the permitted close outcome and reason."}],"counterexamples":[{"source_ids":["brief-a:32","brief-a:34","brief-a:37","brief-a:closing.p1"],"scenario":"After verification, the customer mentions job loss, names a floor amount and valid payment date, then accepts the offer to connect to support.","expected_output":"Validate and read back the customer-named promise, record it only after clear confirmation and successful create_promise, say the required text-message sentence, then transfer to support and close as transferred/support."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:6","brief-a:46"],"scenario":"A relative offers a callback within the allowed date and time window, but schedule_callback returns ok:false.","expected_output":"The source mandates callback scheduling and a not_reached/callback close after the call, but does not state what to do if scheduling fails; this case needs a source amendment."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:16","brief-a:25","brief-a:46"],"scenario":"Identity passes, but get_account returns an empty products list or a failed response.","expected_output":"Do not state debt or invent product details. The source does not define the terminal outcome or reason for this lookup failure; this case needs a source amendment."}]}
